title: A Compass for the Wreck
author: Freya Thornbury
blurb: Theo Marchetti, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
